# `^BX` – Data Matrix Bar Code

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md)


Print a Data Matrix symbol (height, quality, rows/cols, format, and more).

Reference parameters: **o, h, s, c, r, f, g, a**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 144](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
